title: New code insights report
summary: Whether the code added to a project over the last month is healthy and AI-ready: new code per module and package with its median and lowest Code Health, an alert for new technical debt, the share that is AI-optimal, and who to involve.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.description: The CodeScene project to report on. Find it with list_projects.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: New files below this Code Health are flagged as new technical debt.

inputs.name: ai_optimal
inputs.description: Code Health from which code counts as AI-optimal.

inputs.name: max_packages
inputs.description: How many packages the package table shows. 0 shows all.

inputs.name: max_developers
inputs.description: How many developers the developer contributions table shows. 0 shows all.

inputs.name: max_lowest_files
inputs.description: How many files below 10 the lowest Code Health table shows. 0 shows all.
